模块排列未保存，请在设置重试。: Module order was not saved. Retry in Settings.
看见安排，也看见进展。: See your plans and your progress.
浅色虚线表示计划，实线表示已记录的专注。: Light dashed lines show plans. Solid lines show recorded focus.
这段时间还没有安排或专注记录。: No plans or focus records in this period.
按设备本地时间填写。定时事件最多持续 7 天；全天事件只记录日期。: Use the device's local time. Timed events can last up to 7 days. All-day events store a date only.
请填写标题、有效日期或递增的开始与结束时间（最长 7 天）。: Enter a title and a valid date, or increasing start and end times within 7 days.
日历操作未完成。请刷新后重试，未保存的输入已保留。: Calendar action failed. Refresh and retry. Unsaved input has been kept.
任务按日期显示，未指定的具体时间不会被补造。: Tasks appear by date. Unspecified times are never invented.
本地待提交稿未写入，请保留此窗口并完成保存。: The pending local draft was not written. Keep this window open and finish saving.
已完成专注从真实账本读取，不可重复关联。额外手工用时不包含这段专注。: Completed focus comes from the actual ledger and can only be linked once. Additional manual time excludes that focus interval.
练习题数按本周有尝试的不同题目计算。首过率以本周首次尝试的题目为分母；首次尝试通: Problems practiced counts distinct problems attempted this week. First-attempt pass rate divides first-attempt passes by problems first attempted this week. Time belongs to the attempt date. Manual time only adds time outside linked focus.
手动记录题目与尝试，留下解法和真实用时。: Record problems and attempts manually, with solutions and actual time.
操作未保存，输入已保留，请检查后重试。: Not saved. Your input has been kept. Check it and retry.
请在桌面程序中使用，浏览器没有个人数据。: Use the desktop app. The browser has no personal data.
记录已变化，请重新载入后再保存；输入已保留。: This record changed. Reload before saving. Your input has been kept.
该平台与题号已存在，请打开原题增加尝试。: This platform and problem ID already exist. Add an attempt to the existing problem.
这段专注已关联另一条尝试，不能重复计时。: This focus session already belongs to another attempt and cannot count twice.
发现未提交的 Coding 输入，可恢复继续编辑。: Unsubmitted Coding input found. Restore it to continue editing.
可选集成保持当前状态，不会在引导中开启。: Optional integrations keep their current state. Onboarding does not enable them.
托盘和重复启动使用同一应用窗口。自启动默认关闭；通知仅在明确开启后发送，不包含私: The tray and repeated launches use the same application window. Autostart defaults to off. Notifications require opt-in and exclude private text.
关闭主窗口时留在托盘: Keep in tray when the main window closes
通知已提交给系统，实际显示由系统设置决定。: Notification submitted to the OS. System settings determine whether it appears.
桌面服务不可用；仍可使用应用主要功能。: Desktop service unavailable. Main application features remain accessible.
操作未完成，请重新载入；快捷键冲突或系统权限失败不会阻止手动使用。: Action failed. Reload and retry. Shortcut conflicts or system permission failures do not prevent manual use.
桌面集成需要本机桌面应用。: Desktop integration requires the native app.
不可用，关闭窗口会正常退出: Unavailable. Closing the window will exit normally.
接口可用不代表系统一定显示；请在系统通知设置检查。: An available API does not guarantee delivery. Check your OS notification settings.
只保存你明确输入的目标与科目，随时可以跳过。音乐、Spotify和活动追踪无需配: Only goals and subjects you explicitly enter are saved. You can skip anytime. Music, Spotify and activity tracking need no setup.
快捷键（可选，留空保留默认）: Shortcut (optional, leave empty to keep default)
默认 Ctrl + Shift + Space。冲突时可继续进入应用，稍后在设置: Default: Ctrl + Shift + Space. If it conflicts, continue and retry in Settings later.
引导未保存；请检查输入或已有记录后重试。: Onboarding was not saved. Check the input or existing records and retry.
目标与容量已保存，快捷键未更新。可在设置中重试。: Goal and capacity saved. Shortcut unchanged. Retry in Settings.
计划是参考，实际进展由本地计时记录。: Plans are a reference. Local timing records actual progress.
先创建一个任务，再开始专注。: Create a task before starting focus.
系统仍处于锁定或休眠状态，解除后可手动继续。: The system is still locked or asleep. Resume manually after unlocking.
放弃会话后，本次时长不计入实际成果；任务重新安排。: Discarding excludes this session from actual progress and reschedules the task.
暂停、锁屏、休眠和离线时间不计入专注。恢复后由你选择继续或结束。: Paused, locked, sleeping and offline time do not count as focus. After recovery, choose to resume or finish.
检测到计时中断或系统时间变化。: Timing interruption or system clock change detected.
系统曾锁屏或断开会话。: The system locked or disconnected the session.
颜色表示活动强度。特殊日保留记录，免除一致性分母，不影响计划容量。: Color shows activity intensity. Special days keep records and are excluded from the consistency denominator. They do not change planning capacity.
每列一周，周一至周日。强度 0–4；描边为特殊日。Tab 浏览，Enter 查看: Each column is a week, Monday through Sunday. Intensity is 0–4. Outlines mark special days. Tab to browse and Enter to view a day.
可在洞察的活动配置中关闭。: Disable this in Insights activity settings.
本机汇总实际区间、任务、日记、编码与音乐。活动强度只描述记录量。: Local summaries cover actual intervals, tasks, journals, coding and music. Intensity describes recorded activity only.
请在桌面应用中查看本机数据。: Use the desktop app to view local data.
未确认输入已在本机保留，保存成功后清理。: Unconfirmed input is kept locally and cleared after a successful save.
读取或保存失败，输入已保留。: Loading or saving failed. Your input has been kept.
仅导出本机私密快照；含统计标签与词语，不含记录正文或个人心得。: Exports a private local snapshot with statistical labels and words, excluding record bodies and personal reflections.
深度专注按实际跨日区间。编码含关联专注与额外手工时间，与深度专注有重叠，不相加为: Deep focus uses actual intervals across midnight. Coding includes linked focus and additional manual time, so it overlaps with deep focus and must not be added as a total. Tasks count their current state by scheduled date, not historical completion events.
记录摘选（最多 500 条，统计不受此限制）: Record selection (up to 500, statistics have no such limit)
词频按用户日记/快速记录/心得计算；不含系统总结。显示前 50 词，每词最多 2: Word frequency uses journals, quick notes and reflections, excluding system summaries. Shows up to 50 words and 20 sources per word.
让值得记住的，留在这里。: Keep what you want to remember.
记录、草稿和附件都保存在本机，默认私密。: Records, drafts and attachments stay on this device, private by default.
这里还没有记录。写下第一条，也可以打开快速记录。: No entries yet. Write your first one or open Quick capture.
请在桌面程序中使用日记与本地搜索。: Use the desktop app for journals and local search.
操作未完成，草稿仍保留。请重试。: Action failed. Your draft is kept. Please retry.
另一窗口已更新记录。当前草稿已保留，可恢复为新记录，或重新载入最新版本。: Another window updated this entry. Your draft is kept. Restore it as a new entry or reload the latest version.
发现未确认的草稿。恢复会建立新记录，保留原记录。: Unconfirmed draft found. Restoring creates a new entry and keeps the original.
图片或 PDF 最大 20 MB，复制到本机受控目录，不写入数据库 blob。: Images or PDFs up to 20 MB are copied to managed local storage, not stored as database blobs.
默认 Ctrl + Shift + Space；程序运行时可在其他窗口触发。冲突: Default: Ctrl + Shift + Space. Use it from other windows while Lumen runs. Change it if it conflicts.
快捷键不可用，请修改组合；仍可用按钮打开。: Shortcut unavailable. Change the combination or use the button.
记录已保存。可以继续写下一条。: Entry saved. You can write another.
把听过的歌留在本机，让音乐成为这一周的注脚。: Keep listening memories on your device, as a soundtrack to your week.
还没有音乐记录。手动记下一首喜欢的歌。: No music yet. Manually record a favorite song.
音乐历史默认私密，只保存在这台设备，不上传。: Music history is private by default, stored on this device without upload.
默认关闭。只观察当前媒体会话且来源 ID 精确匹配时计时；缺少元数据时请手动记录: Off by default. Only the active media session with an exact source ID match counts. Use manual records when metadata is unavailable.
开启即允许读取该来源的歌曲、艺术家、专辑和播放状态。不会控制播放器，也不会调用网: Enabling permits reading song, artist, album and playback state from this source. It does not control playback or call the network.
系统不提供统一广告标志；已知广告标题会跳过，无法识别的广告可能作为歌曲出现，可在: The OS has no universal advertisement flag. Known ad titles are skipped. Unrecognized ads may appear as songs and can be moved to trash.
Spotify 集成尚未开放，默认关闭。: Spotify integration is not available and defaults to off.
浏览器预览不能保存音乐或读取媒体；请在桌面应用使用。: Browser previews cannot save music or read media. Use the desktop app.
操作失败或版本冲突，输入已保留，请重新载入后重试。: Action failed or version conflicted. Input is kept. Reload and retry.
记录显示最新 100 条，云显示最多 500 组；总计为所选范围全量。: Shows the latest 100 records and up to 500 cloud groups. Totals cover the entire selected range.
媒体暂停时不计时；达到阈值只计一次，后续更新时长。: Paused playback does not count. Reaching the threshold counts once, then updates duration.
未取得可用元数据，手动模式可用: No usable metadata. Manual mode is available.
数据保存在本机。这里的私有导出与公开网站导出相互独立，不会上传或发布。: Data stays on your device. Private export and public website export are separate. Neither uploads or publishes.
保存内容：手动任务、计划、专注、日记、音乐记录、编程尝试、作品及附件。窗口标题、: Stored data includes manually entered tasks, plans, focus, journals, music, coding attempts, works and attachments. Window titles, browser URLs, document names and private text tracking are not implemented or collected by default.
我确认只处理集成采集记录，手动音乐记录保留: I confirm this affects integration-collected records only and keeps manual music
监听已关闭，集成凭据引用已清除。外部服务令牌撤销需在服务账户中完成。: Observation disabled and integration credential references cleared. Revoke external service tokens in the provider account.
JSON 为 lumen-data-backup/1 便携数据备份，包含六类正文: JSON uses lumen-data-backup/1 with six content types and related entities. It excludes attachment files, settings, credentials and integration grants. CSV and Markdown create six file categories. Use a full backup for the complete database, settings and attachments.
我已审阅数量，确认写入这些记录（写入前会创建完整备份）: I reviewed the counts and confirm these writes (a full backup will be created first)
导入完成。重复导入相同记录不会新增重复数据。: Import complete. Importing the same records again does not create duplicates.
先在事务中验证后回滚。冲突或无效记录会阻止确认；仅确认已审阅的文件快照，本地数据: Validation runs in a transaction then rolls back. Conflicts or invalid records block confirmation. Only the reviewed file snapshot can be confirmed. Local changes require a fresh review. Import never enables integration grants.
选择含 COMPLETE 的完整备份目录。先验证校验和、schema、外键与样本: Choose a full backup directory containing COMPLETE. Checksums, schema, foreign keys and samples are verified before copying and opening an isolated database. The current database is not overwritten. The candidate directory and report support a later offline restore.
操作未完成。请检查文件格式、附件、磁盘空间和权限；冲突或过时审阅需重新演练。当前: Action failed. Check file format, attachments, disk space and permissions. Conflicts or stale reviews require a new rehearsal. The current database was not replaced.
需要桌面应用访问本机数据。: The desktop app is required for local data access.
应用运行时每 5 分钟检查；每日只创建一个有效快照。备份包含数据库、设置与附件（: Checks every 5 minutes while running and creates at most one valid daily snapshot. Backups include the database, settings and attachments (including trash), stored locally only.
按最新的日、周、月分桶保留，重叠快照只保留一份。只有新备份校验成功后才清理过期日: Retains recent daily, weekly and monthly buckets, deduplicating overlapping snapshots. Old daily backups are pruned only after a new backup verifies. Manual, migration and exception backups are never automatically pruned.
备份操作失败。原始数据未被替换；请检查磁盘空间、目录权限与附件完整性。: Backup failed. Original data was not replaced. Check disk space, directory permissions and attachment integrity.
备份需要桌面应用；浏览器模式不会访问本机数据。: Backups require the desktop app. Browser mode cannot access local data.
尚无本次会话的每日备份成功记录。: No successful daily backup in this session yet.
备份包含私人内容，请妥善保管。本页不会上传、发布或替换数据库。: Backups contain private content. Store them securely. This page never uploads, publishes or replaces the database.
选择公开范围，查看投影，再手动导出本地网站。: Choose what to share, inspect the projection, then export a local website manually.
公开个人介绍和联系链接: Make introduction and contact links public
当前用户的 Lumen 协议已注册。: Lumen protocol registered for the current user.
默认私有。作品的公开状态在作品库中设置；只有明确公开且未归档、未删除的作品进入网: Private by default. Set work visibility in Vault. Only explicitly public, non-archived and non-deleted works enter the website.
日记、心情、快速捕获、专注原始记录、音乐历史、附件和私有关联不导出。: Journals, moods, quick captures, raw focus records, music history, attachments and private relationships are excluded.
导出是独立快照。更改公开状态后请重新导出，并自行管理旧快照。此处不会自动发布。: Each export is an independent snapshot. Export again after changing visibility and manage old snapshots yourself. No automatic publishing occurs here.
请在桌面应用中编辑和导出；浏览器模式无法访问本地数据库。: Use the desktop app to edit and export. Browser mode cannot access the local database.
操作未完成。请检查链接格式或刷新后重试。: Action failed. Check link formatting or refresh and retry.
请先保存档案，再检查、导出或预览。: Save your profile before inspecting, exporting or previewing.
为当前安装位置注册本地链接。链接只支持预定义页面，不授予文件或数据库访问权限。: Registers local links for the current installation. Links only open predefined pages and grant no file or database access.
容量或固定事件已改变，已接受安排可能超出当前可用时间。请重新生成建议；原安排不会: Capacity or fixed events changed. Accepted plans may exceed available time. Generate a new proposal. Existing plans are never silently rewritten.
把长期目标，放进可承受的日常。: Give long-term goals a sustainable daily place.
先看可用时间，再决定投入。所有建议都由你确认。: Check available time before committing. You confirm every proposal.
规划数据只在桌面程序中读取；浏览器预览不会生成个人记录。: Planning data requires the desktop app. Browser previews create no personal records.
操作未保存，请检查输入或稍后重试。草稿仍保留。: Not saved. Check input or retry later. Drafts are kept.
规划依据或记录已变化，请刷新或重新生成建议。: Planning basis or records changed. Refresh or generate a new proposal.
安排超出容量或最低分配约束，请调整后重试。: The plan exceeds capacity or minimum allocation constraints. Adjust it and retry.
还没有长期目标。从一个目标开始，也可以选择可编辑模板。: No journeys yet. Start with a goal or an editable template.
主动创建后可编辑、归档或删除；模板日期是学习安排，不是招生政策。: You can edit, archive or delete it after creation. Template dates are study plans, not admission policy.
400 仅为 planning target，不是分数预测，也不代表录取概率。: 400 is a planning target only. It predicts neither a score nor admission probability.
最低 ≤ 偏好 ≤ 最多；修改不会自动增大总容量。: Minimum ≤ preferred ≤ maximum. Changes do not automatically increase total capacity.
请检查日期、关联与数值范围，最低分配不能超过偏好或上限。: Check dates, relationships and number ranges. Minimum allocation cannot exceed preference or maximum.
默认只是参考。休息或身体不适时可以将当天容量设为 0。固定事件占用会去重后扣除，: Defaults are references only. Set capacity to 0 for rest or illness. Overlapping fixed events are deducted once. Past dates receive no additional plans.
先在今日或此处创建任务，再关联目标和配置时间约束。: Create tasks in Today or here, then link goals and time constraints.
已有固定时间（不自动分配）: Fixed time already set (no automatic allocation)
生成建议后可先查看原因，尚未接受的建议不会改变安排。: Review the reasoning before accepting. Unaccepted proposals do not change schedules.
资料按年度独立保存。来源必须是支持的官方站；保存的是你提供的文本，SHA256: Sources are stored separately by year and must use supported official sites. Lumen saves the text you supply. SHA256 verifies that text, not the entire original document.
请核对目标年度。现有资料不能自动作为 2028 年政策。: Verify the target year. Existing sources do not automatically establish 2028 policy.
还没有保存年度资料。模板不预填招生规则。: No annual sources saved. Templates do not prefill admissions rules.
留一点空间，做好眼前的事。: Leave space for what matters today.
安排眼前的任务，留下真实的进展。: Plan immediate tasks and record actual progress.
任务保存在这台设备，日期按本地日历记录。: Tasks stay on this device. Dates use the local calendar.
请填写标题、有效日期及 1–1440 分钟的预计时长。: Enter a title, valid date and an estimate of 1–1440 minutes.
浏览器仅展示空状态。请在 Lumen 桌面应用中创建和保存任务。: The browser shows empty states only. Create and save tasks in the Lumen desktop app.
操作未完成，请刷新检查记录后重试。未保存的输入已保留。: Action failed. Refresh to check records, then retry. Unsaved input is kept.
记录已变化，或仍有未结束会话。请刷新后重试。: The record changed or a session is still open. Refresh and retry.
另一个 Lumen 窗口正在使用任务与计时，请在该窗口操作。: Another Lumen window owns tasks and timing. Continue in that window.
今天还没有待办任务。留一点空间，从一件小事开始。: No pending tasks today. Leave some room and start with one small thing.
上次有未结束的会话。离线时间未计入专注；可继续、按最后活动结束，或取消。: An unfinished session was found. Offline time did not count. Resume, finish at last activity, or cancel.
这是可调整的安排参考，不是必须完成的指标。: An adjustable planning reference, not a required target.
安排超过当前容量，可以减少任务或移到其他日期。: Plans exceed current capacity. Reduce tasks or move them to another date.
完成一次专注后，实际记录会出现在这里。: Actual records appear after you complete a focus session.
未来日期的任务到期后出现在 Today。: Future tasks appear in Today when their scheduled date arrives.
记录真实作品、奖项与证书。默认私密，公开作品可在个人档案中手动导出网站，不会自动: Record real works, awards and certificates. Private by default. Export explicitly public works through Profile manually. Nothing uploads automatically.
暂无作品，请录入你的真实记录。: No works yet. Add your real work.
暂无公开作品。预览只显示明确标记为公开、未归档且未删除的记录。: No public works. Preview only shows explicitly public, non-archived and non-deleted records.
先保存作品，再导入20 MB以内图片或PDF。保留文件名、大小、类型与SHA-2: Save the work first, then import images or PDFs under 20 MB. Filename, size, type and SHA256 are kept. Attachments are excluded from public previews.
操作失败或记录已变更。编辑内容已保留，请刷新后重试。: Action failed or the record changed. Edits are kept. Refresh and retry.
当前为浏览器预览，请在桌面应用中录入和管理真实数据。: This is a browser preview. Enter and manage real data in the desktop app.
列表最多显示最近1000项；预览基于此列表。: Lists show up to the latest 1000 items. Preview uses this list.
模块组件暂不可用，其他首页功能仍可使用。: This module widget is unavailable. Other Today features remain usable.
启用控制页面和模块入口；隐藏只改变侧栏。置顶模块优先显示。拖动排列，或用上下按钮: Enable controls routes and entry points. Hide affects the sidebar only. Pinned modules appear first. Drag to reorder or use move buttons. Disabling keeps existing records.
保存失败或版本已变化；当前选择已保留，请重新载入后重试。: Save failed or revision changed. Your selection is kept. Reload and retry.
此模块已停用，可在设置中重新启用。: This module is disabled. Enable it in Settings.
核心模块不能停用；安全系统始终属于 Kernel。: Kernel modules cannot be disabled. Security always belongs to Kernel.
模块配置读取失败；显示默认导航，数据库权限检查仍生效。请在设置重新载入。: Module settings failed to load. Default navigation appears and database permission checks remain active. Reload in Settings.
数据库在这台设备的应用数据目录中。此检查不会创建业务记录。: The database lives in this device's application data directory. This check creates no business records.
仅桌面环境可读取本地数据库。: Only the desktop app can read the local database.
数据库暂不可用。请保留原数据，检查磁盘权限或使用已验证备份。: Database unavailable. Keep the original data. Check disk permissions or use a verified backup.
以下为布局示例，不保存为个人记录。业务功能将在后续阶段开放。: These layout examples do not become personal records. Business features are demonstrated separately.
一段专注，一个小进展，一条值得留下的记录。: A focus session, a small step, a record worth keeping.
